notes.title: 1.6.6 - Small Localization Update
notes.content:
Hey there,

we just uploaded a small update that simplifies the process of adding custom localizations. We've also created a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2960226539]guide[/url] on how to create your own localizations.

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased area for labels in the settings menu
[*] More UI elements scale based on content size now
[/list]

See you in the office,
Emmy and Thomas

notes.title: 1.6.4 - Punch Your Way to the Top
notes.content:
Hey there!

We're excited to bring you our latest update, which includes a new feature that we think you'll love. Here's what's changed:

CHANGELOG:
[list]
[*]Added PUNCHING to the game! You can now push enemies to create space and avoid getting surrounded - or just punch things because it's fun. Enemies don't take damage from being punched, they just fall down.
[*]Added a new achievement for punching.
[*]Added a new hint that appears when a coworker dies, reminding you that you should revive them.
[*]Tutorial text now shows 'E' as the standard interaction key, instead of 'Space'.
[*]Added 'Num0' as an interaction key for players using the arrow keys to move.
[*]Reduced the threat level of the Minigun in the AI director. It should now be less of a death trap.
[/list]

BUG FIXES:
[list]
[*]Fixed interaction range of weapons and jobs in the lobby.
[/list]

We hope you'll have fun punching stuff. Let us know what you think!

See you in the office,
Emmy and Thomas

notes.title: 1.5.26 - Small Accessibility Update
notes.content:
Hey there,
today we have a small accessibility update for you. If you know of any other issues or improvements we can make, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
[list]
[*]Camera can be manually zoomed during play now, using +/- on keyboard or using D-Pad on gamepad.
[*]Altered rug models to be less obtrusive.
[*]Updated control page in main menu.
[/list]

See you in the office,
Emmy and Thomas

notes.title: 1.5.25 - Responsiveness Update
notes.content:
Hey there,
we have a few changes ready for you! Big thank you to all of you who have reported issues!

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased player turn speed.
[*]Removed movement speed penalty when low on health.
[*]Improved the feel of the minigun.
[*]Increased the SMG ammo limit.
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*]The tutorial coffee no longer counts against your performance review.
[*]Fixed tutorial hints disappearing too soon.
[*]Fixed missing haptics on some interactions.
[/list]

See you in the office,
Emmy and Thomas
